notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Goldberry.
Goldberry does not have summoning sickness.
Goldberry and Stormbound Geist do not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Stormbound Geist, adding {U}.
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability and Goldberry trigger.
Resolve the Stormbound Geist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Holding priority, activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Goldberry.
Activate Goldberry's first ability by tapping it, moving the +1/+1 counter from Stormbound Geist onto Goldberry.
Resolve the Goldberry trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Activate Goldberry's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, moving the +1/+1 counter from Goldberry onto any permanent except Stormbound Geist, and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
